name: Crimson sunbird
description: A nectar-feeding bird with a vivid red body and a quick, darting flight through open woodland.
descriptionJa: 花が多い林縁で飛び回る、鮮やかな赤い体を持つ蜜食いの鳥。

name: Olive-backed sunbird
description: A tiny bird with a metallic sheen that feeds on nectar and thrives where flowers are abundant.
descriptionJa: 光沢のある小さな羽を持ち、花が豊富な場所で蜜を食べて暮らす鳥。

name: Red-shanked douc
description: A striking arboreal primate with vivid red limbs and a pale face, moving through the forest canopy in social bands.
descriptionJa: 鮮やかな赤い脚と白い顔を持ち、群れで樹冠を移動する、目を引く樹上のサル。

name: Plaintive cuckoo
habitatJa: 開けた森林と熱帯の境界
description: A soft, echoing call from the canopy and a patient watcher among the branches, often heard before it is seen.
descriptionJa: 樹冠から響く静かな声で知られ、枝の間でじっと見守る忍び寄るような鳥。

name: White wagtail
description: A lively, tail-bobbing bird that follows water edges and open ground in search of insects.
descriptionJa: 水辺や広い芝生を歩きながら、尾を上下に振って昆虫を探す活発な鳥。

name: The red squirrel
description: A nimble climber with a remarkable sense of balance, built for life among branches.
descriptionJa: 枝の上での生活に合わせた、驚くほどバランスの良い敏捷な木登り動物。

name: Siberian stonechat
habitatJa: 開けた低木地帯と畑の縁
description: A lively, upright songbird that perches on exposed stems and calls from the edge of open country.
descriptionJa: 露出した茎に止まり、開けた原野の縁で鳴きながら活発に動く鳥。

name: Whiskered tern
description: A graceful wetland tern that skims over shallow water to catch insects and small fish.
descriptionJa: 浅い水面を滑るように飛び、昆虫や小魚を捕らえる優雅な湿地のアジサシです。

name: Chipmunk
habitatJa: 森林の空き地と生け垣
description: A compact ground forager with striped cheeks and a quick instinct for sheltering among roots and stones.
descriptionJa: 頬に縞模様があり、根や石の間に身を隠す本能がすばやい小さな地上採食動物。

name: Brown flycatcher
description: A poised insect hunter that snaps up prey mid-air in quick, flickering bursts.
descriptionJa: 空中で小さな獲物を素早く捕らえる、落ち着いた昆虫食の鳥。

name: Stripe-throated bulbul
description: A lively songbird with a warm olive coat and a bright throat stripe that stands out in the morning light.
descriptionJa: 明るい喉の縞模様が目立ち、朝の光に映える活発な鳴き鳥。

name: Paddyfield pipit
description: A small, ground-feeding bird that flicks through open grasslands and wet fields with quick, running steps.
descriptionJa: 水田や草地を素早く走り回り、開けた場所を移動する小さな地上の鳥。

name: Yellow-bellied prinia
habitatJa: 背の高い草地、ヨシ原、湿地の縁
description: A small, active warbler with a yellow underside, often heard chattering as it moves through dense grass and reeds.
descriptionJa: 黄色い腹部を持つ活発な小鳥で、茂った草地やヨシ原を動き回りながらにぎやかにさえずります。

name: Dusky warbler
description: A small, brownish warbler that keeps low in dense vegetation, searching for insects among leaves and branches.
descriptionJa: 茂った植生の低い場所で、葉や枝の間の昆虫を探す小さな褐色のウグイス類です。

name: Pacific golden plover
habitatJa: 北極圏のツンドラ、干潟、沿岸湿地
description: A migratory shorebird that breeds on Arctic tundra and winters on open coasts and wetlands across the Pacific.
descriptionJa: 北極圏のツンドラで繁殖し、太平洋各地の海岸や湿地で越冬する渡り性のシギ・チドリ類です。

name: Great knot
habitatJa: 沿岸の干潟と潮汐湿地
description: A long-distance migratory shorebird that gathers on coastal mudflats to feed on shellfish and other invertebrates.
descriptionJa: 長距離を渡るシギで、沿岸の干潟に集まり、貝類などの無脊椎動物を食べます。

name: White-faced plover
description: A coastal shorebird with a distinctive pale face, foraging along sandy shores and tidal flats in East and Southeast Asia.
descriptionJa: 特徴的な白い顔を持つ沿岸性のシギ・チドリ類で、東アジアや東南アジアの砂浜や干潟で餌を探します。

name: Purple heron
description: A tall, secretive heron that hunts fish and other small prey among reeds and shallow wetlands.
descriptionJa: ヨシ原や浅い湿地で魚などの小さな獲物を狩る、背の高い警戒心の強いサギです。

name: Black drongo
habitatJa: 開けた草地、農地、低木地
description: A glossy black songbird with a forked tail, often seen perched in open areas while hunting insects.
descriptionJa: 二股に分かれた尾を持つ光沢のある黒い鳥で、開けた場所に止まりながら昆虫を捕らえます。

name: Blue rock thrush
habitatJa: 岩の多い海岸、崖、山の斜面
description: A solitary songbird that perches on exposed rocks, where the male's deep blue plumage stands out.
descriptionJa: 岩場に単独で止まることが多い鳥で、オスの深い青色の羽がよく目立ちます。
